description: This file defines a PHP class 'LDAPAuthProvider' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\LDAP\Dto'. It encapsulates LDAP authentication provider data with private properties for user distinguished name (DN) and user ID, along with getter methods and a constructor. The class serves as a data transfer object (DTO) used for LDAP authentication in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Data transfer object representing an LDAP authentication provider, encapsulating user DN and user ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LDAPAuthProvider with specified user DN and user ID.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the LDAP user.
